channel.title: Aviation, shipping & logistics · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Aviation, shipping & logistics in Indian markets. Today: mixed (−0.4).

item.title: [−2] Iran says a supertanker with 2 million barrels sank after mine strikes; India reports a tanker attack
item.description:
Iran's Guards warned ships the strait is closed to unauthorised transit; Indian authorities said a tanker was attacked near Hormuz with crew safe. The US says routes are swept. Escalating from three ships on Saturday.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: headwind (−2) — War-risk premiums, crew danger

Why it matters: A sinking, if confirmed, would lift war-risk premiums and tanker rates sharply on India's main crude and LNG route, even while overall flows recover.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Brent slips 47 cents to $95.37 in Asia as Gulf shipments near pre-war levels and a surplus looms
item.description:
WTI fell 23 cents to $88.33. Traders cited recovering Hormuz flows, the IEA's fourth-quarter surplus forecast and weak Chinese demand, despite new mine claims and an Iranian drone attack on Bahrain. Easing for a third week.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Fuel costs ease

Why it matters: Crude drifting lower despite Gulf attacks suggests supply is winning over fear, which trims India's import bill and fuel-inflation risk.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1, Fiscal & trade balance +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] A major Japanese container line sends its first ship through the Red Sea and Suez in three years
item.description:
It follows another large carrier's return last week, signalling a gradual resumption by big shipping lines; 122 LNG carriers also used the canal in three months. Easing, though Houthi threats still divert some ships.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Shorter routes, lower freight

Why it matters: Shorter Suez routings cut transit times and freight costs for India's exports to Europe and the US east coast.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Iran claims six-drone attack on a US base in Bahrain; anti-Houthi forces retreat near Bab el-Mandeb
item.description:
Bahrain issued its first nationwide alerts since September and said the drones were intercepted; the US reported no damage. In Yemen, government forces pulled back near the Red Sea strait. New escalation after Friday's radar strike.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — Red Sea route risk

Why it matters: Attacks on Gulf states and a stronger Houthi hold on Bab el-Mandeb threaten both of India's westward energy and trade routes and raise the chance of renewed US strikes.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
